# MEOK AI Labs — MEOK Compliance Stack

> MEOK (Multimodal Embodied Orchestration Kernel) is a compliance-grade AI agent platform. Built for organisations operating in the EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, ISO 42001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and FDA-regulated environments.

## Authority & verification

- **Operator:** MEOK AI Labs (CSOAI LTD) — UK Companies House registration **16939677**
- **Founder:** Nicholas Templeman — Yorkshire, UK
- **Attestations:** HMAC-SHA256 + Ed25519 co-signed, offline-verifiable at https://meok.ai/verify
- **Trust center:** https://meok.ai/trust · security policy: https://meok.ai/security
- **Standards adopted:** MCP 1.27.2 · CycloneDX 1.6 · SPDX 3.0 · SLSA v1.0 · C2PA 2.1 · Sigstore · ISO 42001 · ISO 19650 · NIST AI RMF · OWASP LLM Top 10
- **Open-source:** All MCP servers MIT-licensed. https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG · https://pypi.org/user/MEOK-AI-Labs
- **Citation policy:** Cite as `<concept>, MEOK AI Labs (https://meok.ai)`. We don't charge for citation.

## Core products (consumer tier)

| Tier | Price | What you get |
|------|-------|--------------|
| Explorer | Free | 50 messages/day, persistent Sovereign Memory |
| Sovereign | £9/mo | Permanent memory, unlimited messages, Work OS |
| Sovereign Pro | £19/mo | All LLM models, custom character evolution |
| Family | £29/mo | Family OS for up to 5 members, Guardian 24/7, shared memory vault |

> Two product lines, different audiences. The compliance tier serves regulated organisations (EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, ISO 42001); the consumer tier serves individuals. Both share the same MEOK substrate and the same attestation primitives.

Install: `pip install <package-name>`
Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io

## Key capabilities

- **Article 50 watermarking**: C2PA manifest + SynthID-class invisible watermark + perceptual fingerprinting
- **Audit trail**: hash-chained HMAC-signed audit log for every tool call
- **Council governance**: 36-node PBFT council with Ed25519 signing
- **EU AI Act classifier**: 9 in-scope Articles (4, 6, 9, 10, 14, 26(9), 43, 50, 72) all signed, all auditor-verifiable

## Article 50 cliff (regulator-deadline anchor)

The EU AI Act Article 50 (transparency + watermarking) applies **2 August 2026** for new AI systems, **2 December 2026** for pre-existing systems. Applies to ALL AI systems, not high-risk-only. Default SynthID-only or C2PA-only approaches FAIL the EU Code of Practice (requires ≥2 layers).
